mystery.en: Why does one exact note SHATTER a wine glass?

en.title: Q-Factor and Wine-Glass Fracture
en.teaser: A tone locked to the rim eigenfrequency stores energy until hoop stress snaps the glass.

en.hook: Can one pure musical note store enough energy to shatter solid crystal?
en.math: At resonance the drive matches the glass eigenfrequency, and a high Q-factor stacks energy every cycle until hoop stress exceeds the strength of silica.
en.question: Can we simulate acoustic glass resonance in Kotlin Multiplatform?
en.code_tip: We integrate the driven-oscillator amplitude with Q-factor bandwidth and a silica fracture threshold.
en.payoff: Resonant ring-up and wine-glass fracture running live in Kotlin.
